record.source_text: The additions and deductions shall be taken into account in the profit of the first profit determination period after the change, and in the case of the sale or abandonment of the entire business, of a part-business or of a co-entrepreneur’s interest in the profit of the last profit determination period before the sale or abandonment. 2.
